# DirectionToggle

Reading-direction switch.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.DirectionToggle` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.DirectionToggle />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.DirectionToggle"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Two-segment LTR / RTL switch. Sets dir + lang on <html>, persists the choice, and dispatches a `cory:direction` window event for scripts that cache layout.

## Props (DirectionToggleProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | 36 / 44 / 52px. @default "md" |
| `variant` | `'secondary' \| 'onInk'` | @default "secondary" |
| `rtlLang` | `string` | lang written to <html> in RTL. @default "ar" |
| `ltrLang` | `string` | lang written to <html> in LTR. @default "en" |
| `storageKey` | `string` | localStorage key. @default "cory-dir" |
| `labels` | `{ ltr: React.ReactNode; rtl: React.ReactNode }` | Segment labels. @default { ltr: "LTR", rtl: "RTL" } |
| `onChange` | `(dir: 'ltr' \| 'rtl') => void` |  |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>._
